name: Held Shot
description: Settle in. Every turn spent holding adds 60% to the shot you eventually take. The charge is spent the moment you fire, hit or miss.

name: Longshot
description: Releases the charge into one target. Heavy on its own; ruinous after three turns of holding.

name: Recon
description: Calls the field. Everything on it is target-locked for two turns, so nobody in the party can miss.

name: Patience
description: Wait. Guard until your next turn and put six into the party's Tempo while you do.

name: Killing Silence
description: Capstone. One shot that cannot miss and that armor, shields, Guard and immunity are not consulted about. Spends the whole charge.
